notes.title: Balancing Patch!
notes.notes: We did a lot of rebalancing: changed how curses are spawned (both their values and the quantity) nerfed the starting deck and starting hand size, fixed how maximum hand size is handled and much more!

notes.title: MAJOR BUILD UPDATE! SCORE, LEVEL UPS, ASPECTS, REMOVED DRAFT CARDS & MORE!
notes.notes:
So much was changed in this update, we removed draft cards, now drafts are gained by purging curses. We added a scoring system where players gain score by building certain links allowing them to level up. We removed rituals and items and put them all into aspects which can be stored by the player provided they have enough attunement to hold them

Improved the card and curses visual designs, changed the starting deck and more!

We had to disable the tutorial for now until we can re-build it for the new mechanics. Working on that!

notes.title: Small bug fix - hand duplication
notes.notes: fixed a bug where your hand could duplicate when opening a view during a discard selection

notes.title: Quick re-patch to solve new player opening screen
notes.notes: Just a quick fix of a small issue

notes.title: ADDED A TUTORIAL!! MAJOR CHANGES
notes.notes: Wow where to begin. We added a tutorial, unlockable content, removed the fate select screen, moved the drafting selection process to take place after each turn, allowed the players to spend draft picks on rituals, events and items. So many bug fixes and much much more!

notes.title: 7/2/2025 patch
notes.notes: Lots of bug fixes, hopefully solved the "missing image" bug during boss fights

notes.title: 6/28/25: A Litany of Changes
notes.notes:
Added a variety of fixes and updates. Major two are
Added boss rewards (currently placeholders, but still meaningful upgrades)
Updated the character select/deck select UI

notes.title: HOTFIX!
notes.notes:
Solves: Save/continue bugs
Life gain/loss bugs
rituals not triggering
other misc turn continuity issues
Issue where things the boss created had to be shown one by one
solved the issue where the deck was displayed in order

notes.title: 6/17/25 patch
notes.notes:
Major Visual updates: updated title screen and fate select screens.

Many various bug fixes!

notes.title: 6/12/25 Afternoon patch
notes.notes:
Completely redid the pacing of the game. Now each act has on average 3 turns (and eventually a boss). Turn 1 opens with fate select and receiving curses.

Added "Act transitions" so you can more easily follow when acts change. 

Color coded each act

Updated selection process to happen automatically (no need to click confirm button in most cases)

Updated the discard UI to make it more obvious (hand moves up in line with where other decisions happen)

notes.title: Evening Patch 6/11/25
notes.notes:
Updated the "view/choice" windows to switch to grid mode when the quantity is large (I believe I set it to 18 cards as the cutoff, open to feedback on this). 

Note these windows are scrollable via mouse wheel, although there is no current indicator of the scrollability yet, it felt worth pushing in its current state 

Fixed reminder text being case sensitive

Relaxed the ritual conditions "Cannot play X link type" to only impact links of a single type (HUGE change there)

removed careful selection triggering on itself being played

many bug fixes, such as issues with purging multiple curses at once, seeking/tutoring curses, card effects lingering between turns, prevented using abilities when the fate select screen is open.

notes.title: Update notes for 6/11/25
notes.notes: Fixed "this counts as two cards in a link" cards to work as expected. Updated rituals to have two foresight instead of 1. Fixed two other misc bugs that caused crashes when checking valence against curses.

notes.title: Patch notes for 6/10/2025
notes.notes:
Significantly overhauled the curse difficulty and distribution algorithm. Act 1 curses should be harder, Act 3 curses should be easier.

A lot of QOL stuff. Greatly improved reminder text, fixed rewards not being hover able when you exceeded 10, fixed issues with data not resetting between runs. Fixed display buttons locking after switching views. Fixed when opening screen would hardlock when clicked too early. Helped icons load on game start when internet is down.
